description: Discover Little Cottage Company greenhouses, featuring customizable designs, easy assembly, and year-round gardening benefits for every gardener.

Little Cottage Company makes high-quality greenhouses for home gardeners. Here's what you need to know:

  • 4 models: Colonial Gable, Garden Shed, Petite, Octagon
  • Prices start at $6,393 for Colonial Gable model
  • DIY assembly with easy-to-follow instructions
  • Durable vinyl frames and polycarbonate panels
  • Customizable with paint, shelving, vents, and flooring options
  • Free shipping on all models

Key benefits:

  • Grow plants year-round
  • Protect from pests and weather
  • Control temperature and humidity
  • Suitable for vegetables, herbs, and flowers

Most customers praise the:

  • Attractive designs
  • Sturdy construction
  • Good ventilation

Some drawbacks:

  • Limited size options
  • Higher price point
  • Occasional shipping delays

Little Cottage Company greenhouses offer a solid option for year-round gardening, combining functionality with attractive design. While pricier than some alternatives, they provide durability and customization options that many gardeners find worthwhile.

Little Cottage Company Greenhouses

Since 1999, Little Cottage Company has been making outdoor structures, including greenhouses. Here's why their greenhouses might be perfect for you:

Company Goals

This family-owned business focuses on:

  • Top-quality products
  • Great customer service
  • Cool designs

Their greenhouses? Made in the USA with sturdy 2x4 construction.

What Sets Them Apart

1. Easy to Put Together

You can choose from:

  • Panelized Kits
  • Precut Kits

Both are simple enough for most homeowners to assemble.

2. Make It Your Own

Want to paint your greenhouse? Go for it! Just remember:

  • Paint isn't included
  • You'll need to buy it separately

3. Lots of Options

4. Customer-Friendly Policies

  • Free shipping (yes, really!)
  • They'll beat lower prices you find elsewhere

5. Quality Stuff

"Our team takes pride in making products that'll serve you for years." - Little Cottage Company

Just remember, you'll need to supply:

  • Shingles
  • Drip edge
  • Paint

Greenhouse Models

Little Cottage Company offers four greenhouse models. Let's break them down:

Colonial Gable

This classic model costs $6,393 and features:

  • Traditional gable roof
  • Spacious interior

Perfect for gardeners who want a timeless look and lots of growing space.

Garden Shed

Combines growing space with storage. It's great for:

  • Storing tools and supplies
  • Year-round plant growing
  • Making the most of your yard space

Petite

Ideal for small outdoor spaces. It offers:

  • Compact design for small yards or patios
  • Room for essential plants and herbs
  • Easy fit into existing landscaping

Octagon

Stands out with its unique 8-sided shape. Features:

  • 360-degree light exposure
  • Interesting garden focal point
  • Efficient interior space use

All models ship free and are designed for DIY assembly. No need to hire a pro - most homeowners can set these up themselves.

Greenhouse Features and Benefits

Little Cottage Company greenhouses are more than just plant homes. They're backyard showpieces that work hard and look good doing it.

Looks That Impress

These aren't your average greenhouses. They're mini cottages for your plants. Take the Colonial Gable model - it's got a peaked roof that screams "charming country cottage." Your neighbors might think you've added a tiny guest house.

Built to Last

Little Cottage Company doesn't mess around with materials:

  • Frames? Vinyl that laughs at bad weather.
  • Panels? Polycarbonate that blocks UV rays and lets the good light in.
  • Hardware? It'll stay rust-free long after you've forgotten where you put your pruning shears.

This stuff is built to take a beating and keep your plants cozy for years.

Make It Yours

Want a greenhouse that's all you? Little Cottage Company's got you covered:

Mix and match until you've got a greenhouse that fits your style and your gardening game plan.

Setting Up Your Greenhouse

Let's turn that Little Cottage Company greenhouse kit into your plant paradise. Here's how:

DIY Assembly

1. Prep the site

Find a level spot in your yard. Got a foundation kit? Start there.

2. Sort parts

Group similar pieces. Trust me, it'll save you time later.

3. Build the frame

Start at the bottom, work your way up. The vinyl pieces snap together easily.

4. Add panels

Slide in those polycarbonate panels. They're tough but light.

5. Finish up

Install the door, vents, and any extras.

Need Help?

If DIY isn't your thing, you've got options:

Your Toolkit

For DIY, grab these:

  • Drill (Phillips head bit)
  • Ladder
  • Level
  • Measuring tape
  • Work gloves
  • A friend (don't go solo)

Quick Tip: Plan for a full weekend. Take your time - rushing leads to mistakes.

Getting the Most from Your Greenhouse

Where to Put It

Choosing the right spot for your greenhouse is crucial. Here's what matters:

  • Close to your house
  • Near a water source
  • Access to electricity
  • Good sun exposure
  • Proper drainage

Quick tip: If your spot tends to flood, build up the soil and add drainage.

Temperature Control

Keeping your greenhouse at the right temperature is key. Here's how:

  • Size your HVAC system correctly
  • Use under-crop heating
  • Install shade curtains
  • Add horizontal fans

Watering

Greenhouse plants need special care. Follow these rules:

  • Water in the morning
  • Check soil moisture first
  • Use room-temp water
  • Group similar plants together

Think about getting a drip system on a timer. It's great when you're away.

Remember: Greenhouse plants dry out fast. Keep an eye on them and adjust as needed.

Growing Plants in Your Greenhouse

Best Plants to Grow

Greenhouses are perfect for growing:

  • Tomatoes
  • Peppers
  • Cucumbers
  • Herbs (basil, cilantro, parsley)
  • Leafy greens (lettuce, spinach, kale)

These plants love the steady warmth and moisture greenhouses provide.

Growing All Year

Want to garden year-round? A Little Cottage Company greenhouse has you covered:

  • Spring: Jump-start your seedlings
  • Summer: Grow heat-lovers
  • Fall: Keep warm-season crops going
  • Winter: Grow cold-hardy veggies

To keep your greenhouse productive all year:

  • Use tough materials like glass or thick treated plastic
  • Add electric heaters for winter
  • Use black-painted water jugs to soak up and release heat

Dealing with Pests

Pests love greenhouses too. Here's how to fight back:

1. Check Often: Look for aphids, mites, and whiteflies regularly.

2. Hand-Pick: For small pest problems, just remove them manually.

3. DIY Repellent: Mix up this natural pest deterrent:

Spread it around your greenhouse edges.

4. Air It Out: Use vents to cut humidity and slow pest growth.

5. Give Plants Space: Don't crowd your plants. Good airflow helps.

"Pests will go after your indoor plants just like they do outdoor ones." - Jennifer Poindexter, Mother Earth News blogger.

What Customers Say

Little Cottage Company greenhouse owners are generally happy with their purchases. Here's what they're saying:

"My Colonial Gable greenhouse is a game-changer. My tomatoes and peppers are bigger and tastier than ever. Plus, I can grow for months longer!" - Sarah Johnson, Ohio

"Three years in, my greenhouse still looks great after harsh winters. I start planting early spring and keep going into fall." - Tom Miller, Maine

Users love:

  • Easy assembly
  • Attractive design
  • Sturdy build
  • Good ventilation

But some aren't fans of:

  • Limited size options
  • Price point
  • Slow shipping
  • Unclear assembly instructions

Landscape designer Lisa Chen raves:

"It's not just useful, it's a beautiful focal point my clients love."

However, there's room for improvement:

"I wish there were more size options for smaller yards." - Jack Thompson, Florida

Despite a few gripes, most users find Little Cottage Company greenhouses live up to the hype, giving them a solid year-round growing space.

Conclusion

Little Cottage Company greenhouses let you grow more, for longer. They come in different styles: Colonial Gable, Garden Shed, Petite, and Octagon. Each fits different spaces and gardening goals.

These greenhouses work well and look good. Gardeners like how easy they are to put together and how they stand up to tough weather.

Here's what you get:

  • Grow plants when it's cold outside
  • Keep bugs and bad weather away from your plants
  • Grow plants that usually don't do well in your area

Most people love these greenhouses. They say their plants grow better and they can garden all year. But some wish there were more size options or that prices were lower.

If you're thinking about getting one:

  • Pick the right size and style for your yard
  • Put it where it gets lots of sun
  • Make sure you can control the heat and water inside

Little Cottage Company greenhouses can really step up your gardening game. They're a solid choice for anyone who wants to grow more, no matter the season.
